svg.text: Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
Create host pool → networking and domain join
Use the approved lab VNet/subnet with required outbound AVD/Entra/Microsoft service
connectivity. Do not assign a public IP to the session host or open internet-facing 3389. AVD’s
supported reverse-connect access is not the same as exposing RDP directly.
Choose Microsoft Entra ID join for this first exercise and confirm the required sign-in
extension/deployment options in the current wizard. Use the generated .onmicrosoft.com learner
identity if lab.example.test has not separately been verified in this tenant. Do not try to
create another AD forest with the same name.
Leave Intune enrollment off unless its entitlement and enrollment design were explicitly
included. This exercise does not require renting Entra Domain Services or connecting your home
AD through a paid VPN gateway.
Check: The host has a supported identity/network design without public RDP or surprise identity
